target.statement: LayoutDiT achieves Ove = 0.0012 on the PKU annotated dataset in unconstrained generation, outperforming RALF (0.0069) and other baselines.

compute.basis: Training a 49M-parameter diffusion transformer for 500 epochs on PKU (batch size 32) plus evaluation; on CPU this is feasible but slow, likely 10-15 hours, while a mid-range GPU would reduce it to 2-3 hours.

blockers: Code and data are linked but not directly provided in the paper; reproduction requires finding and downloading from the project page and external sources.
Training a diffusion model for 500 epochs is computationally intensive for a CPU-only laptop.
The exact train/val/test split (8:1:1) from RALF may need to be replicated, which could introduce variability.
title: LayoutDiT: Exploring Content-Graphic Balance in Layout Generation with Diffusion Transformer
